request.style: English, male baritone solo with backing choir, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, light percussion, solemn and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
LORD how many foes surround me now
Many rise to bring me down
They say there is no help for me
No hope in God to be seen

[Chorus]
But you LORD are a shield around me
My glory that lifts my head high
I call aloud to you in need
You answer me from your holy mountain

[Verse]
I lie down and sleep in peace
I wake again sustained by grace
The tens of thousands on every side
Cannot make me fear your ways

[Chorus]
But you LORD are a shield around me
My glory that lifts my head high
I call aloud to you in need
You answer me from your holy mountain

[Bridge]
Rise up LORD and save me now
My God you strike the enemies
You break the teeth of the wicked ones
And bring them to their end

[Outro]
You are my shield and my glory
My head lifted high in your light
